notes.title: 2/18 Update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! For this update I went ahead and added an options menu for you all, so you guys will be able to adjust the game and better your experience when playing. The options menu can be found in both the main menu and the pause menu (accessed by pressing esc). I also adjusted the candle tutorial as I had some people reach out about how the press G was not working for them. Please let me know if you guys find anything else and I will work quickly to fix it. You can let me know either in the Discussions page under Bugs or through the Google Forms Link.

I just want to thank everyone again for taking the time to try my game! It means so much and I hope with this update it will make everyone's gaming experience a lot better!

notes.title: 2/12/25 Update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
This update added a reminder widget for after a jump scare how to take out your candle again as I saw some people unsure of what to do when it went dark. I also noticed the montage in the credits was not playing, so I believe I have fixed that as well.

Please let me know if you guys find anything else or if there is any other constructive feedback. You can leave it in the community page discussion section under Bugs or fill out the Google Forms link. 

Thank you to everyone who has tried my game! It means the world to me and if you were one of the people who were unable to finish it or were unsure how to proceed, I would love it if you tried it again, I have added a lot more tutorial elements that I believe help you guys be able to finish it!
